title: U.S. UAP Research Faces Data Gaps as Department of War Releases Records
description: NASA urged stronger sensor records, while Avi Loeb says a separate advisory council and the government’s records program are pursuing further study.

title: Is the truth really out there? Studying UAP sightings
description: It's been some 75 years since the term Unidentified Flying Object (or UFO) was coined to describe the mysterious airborne phenomena witnessed by pilots and the public. Now, Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena (UAPs) are the focus of a new Scientific Advisory Council, led by Avi Loeb of Harvard, which is investigating the staggering number of first-person accounts, video and documents recently released by the government. Correspondent Luke Burbank looks at how scientists hope to study these sightings, to possibly answer the question: Are we alone?

title: Former Pentagon UFO chief disputes FBI black triangle sighting, says reports lack evidence
description: The former Pentagon UFO office chief says the FBI's triangular object sighting lacks evidence, calling witness credibility a 'classic authority bias.'
